Please give it some attention

Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Travelers with companion animals should contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure so we can help confirm comfort needs and prepare for smooth handling.

A welfare coordinator reviews each animal's comfort needs with care, and our staff works to keep communication prompt, respectful, and clear. Please share any concern about feeding, rest, handling, or travel conditions as soon as it is known, so the right support can be arranged without delay.

When you arrive, please keep your animal secure and under control, and follow the guidance given by the desk or by airport staff. If plans change, let us know at once so we can update the support record and reduce stress for you and your animal. Clear notice helps us respond with care and avoid confusion at the counter or gate.

For assistance, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
